item.title: 🔴 DHS confirms hackers breached HSIN info-sharing platform
item.description:
Why this matters: Potential data exposure — check monitoring and incident response readiness.
The Department of Homeland Security is investigating a cyberattack that compromised the Homeland Security Information Network (HSIN), a sensitive information-sharing platform used by federal, state, local, and private-sector partners. [...]

item.title: 🔴 AI-Generated Browser Ransomware Abuses Chromium API on Windows and Android
item.description:
Why this matters: Elevated ransomware risk — validate backups and endpoint defenses.
